_instructions: Setting descriptors for the configuration composer (see config/configuration/settings-catalog.json). Current values are always read live; descriptors hold no defaults.

settings.description: Longest voice dictation, in seconds, before recording stops.
Minutes of no use before the text-to-speech model is unloaded from memory.
examples: unload the voice model after 5 minutes

settings.description: Drop um, uh and accidentally doubled words from dictated text (local rules, no model).
examples: keep um and uh in dictated text
stop removing repeated words from dictation

settings.description: Default for agents that do not choose: after dictation stops, have the agent's System model remove filler words and repeated words and fix punctuation in the dictated text.
examples: clean up my dictation with the model
stop the model editing my dictation
